- We require bank account verification for ACH: HarborPoint should complete the BankForm (I attached a blank template in my reply). If they prefer wire, we need originator bank details + beneficiary account + intermediary if any.
- PO legal name: use Redwood Inference, Inc. with our corporate tax ID 94-1234567.
- For larger contracts (> $250k ARR) Finance wants to review payment milestones before POs are issued. Ask them if they're expecting a standing PO or per-project POs.

Thanks Emily — got the completed bank form. Answers inline below and next steps:

1) Invoice remit line: please include the full remit address on the first invoice (we ingest the full address) but for recurring invoices our AP system prefers the single-line remit field. Put both on the invoice (full address in the remittance block, single-line in header).

2) Contract signing: DocuSign is fine. Primary signer for Redwood: Mei Wong (meiw@redwood.com), VP Finance. We route contracts through Legal first for signature if the T&Cs deviate from our standard SOW.

Next steps for HarborPoint:
- Send completed invoice sample with both remit formats to ap@redwood.com (cc procurement@redwood.com).
- Sign the PO/terms via DocuSign link (I'll send via Legal once Jordan sets the vendor code).
- Once we receive the signed PO and first invoice sample, Jordan will create your vendor code and Kimberly will confirm account setup for ACH.

Marissa, could you please add this account to the onboarding tracker and flag for a Finance review if expected deal value >$250k?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get you onboarded.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference
